marta (CSM): Heads-up: HorizonAI submitted their vendor security questionnaire. Main asks: SOC2 Type II PDF, DPA redline (DSARs + deletion timelines), embedding persistence questions, and a request for either BYOK or a formal technical attestation for encryption-in-transit + at-rest. Procurement wants answers within 5 business days.

marta (CSM): Their exact wording on embeddings: "Do you persist embeddings beyond request lifecycle? If yes, describe storage, retention, and pseudonymization controls and how deletions are executed on request."

lee (Security): Copy. I can export the current SOC2 Type II cert and the list of subprocessors. On BYOK vs attestation: we have two customer options — hosted with attestation + 45d retention for embeddings, or Private with full BYOK and longer retention. Need to confirm runtime support for deletion proof (S3 lifecycle + DB tombstones).

shreya (Legal): I'll take the DPA redline. Common DSAR ask: 30-day response SLA and proof of deletion. If they want specific rotation clauses for keys we can offer standard BYOK language or a Private deployment addendum. Ask them if they require key provenance logs in the contract or if an operational attestation suffices.

marta (CSM): Pasting their procurement note: "If vendor cannot provide BYOK and per-record deletion proofs within 10 business days, we will pause procurement. Favor Private unless Redwood can produce attestation plus a DPA amendment."

ops-bot: Uploaded: https://drive.redwood/horizonai/evidence/soc2-typeii-2025.pdf
ops-bot: Uploaded: https://drive.redwood/horizonai/evidence/subprocessors-2026-03.csv

sam (Solutions): For embeddings: our hosted inference keeps ephemeral KV caches and stores user embeddings in a tenant-scoped vector index with configurable retention. Default hosted retention is 90d but we can set 45d for specific customers. Deletion flow: API delete -> background job removes vectors -> DB purge + S3 lifecycle; we can capture a purge log line.

lee (Security): I'll prepare a short technical attestation covering TLS, KMS usage, key separation between tenants, rotation policy, and audit logs for key usage. Also will include an example purge log and an example vector-store deletion entry. ETA EOD.

shreya (Legal): I'll craft two DPA tracks: (1) Hosted DPA amendment (adds 45d embedding retention + attestation and DSAR process), (2) Private deployment addendum (BYOK + key provenance clause). Recommend offering track 1 first.

marta (CSM): Sales prefer hosted if possible. I'll propose track 1 and escalate to Private only if they insist.

marta (CSM): Internal action items:
- marta: send SOC2 + subprocessors to customer (done via ops-bot links)
- lee: draft technical attestation + attach purge log sample
- shreya: redline DPA (hosted amendment + optional private addendum)
- sam: confirm technical steps and provide vector store deletion evidence path

ops-bot: Evidence index for reviewers:
/evidence/soc2/horizonai/soc2-typeii-2025.pdf
/evidence/subprocessors/horizonai-2026-03.csv
/evidence/kms/horizonai-byok-attestation.md
/evidence/embeddings/horizonai-vector-deletion-sample.log

lee (Security): Uploaded attestations: https://drive.redwood/horizonai/evidence/horizonai-byok-attestation.md and https://drive.redwood/horizonai/evidence/vector-deletion-sample.log

shreya (Legal): Draft redline uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood/horizonai/dpa/horizonai-dpa-redline.docx. Included hosted amendment with explicit DSAR SLA (30 days) and deletion proof obligations; optional private addendum attached.

marta (CSM): I emailed procurement with hosted proposal: SOC2 + hosted amendment (45d embeddings) + technical attestation. Asked them to confirm whether contract language needs BYOK or if attestation is sufficient.

(elapsed): 3 days later

marta (CSM): Procurement responded: accepted hosted amendment + attestation. They asked for one minor DPA tweak: require a monthly audit evidence extract for key usage (redwood will provide a CSV extract upon request).

lee (Security): Monthly extract is operationally feasible. I'll add a short procedure for generating the CSV and a sample extract to the evidence folder.

shreya (Legal): I applied the procurement tweak to the DPA redline and re-uploaded. Final DPA signed.

marta (CSM): Final status: SOC2 Type II delivered, subprocessors shared, DPA signed with hosted amendment (45d embeddings), technical attestation and monthly key-usage extract agreed. Procurement closed. Renewal risk: low. Closing ticket and moving onboarding to complete. :white_check_mark:
